profile.headline: Web Developer & Designer, Marketing Specialist
profile.jobTitle: Web Developer & Designer, Graphic Artist, Marketing Specialist
profile.summary:
With over 15 years of client-facing experience, my background blends creativity, strategy, technical expertise and business development to design and develop engaging websites, build strong visual identities, and develop marketing systems that drive measurable results.

I approach every project with both design and performance in mind. From site architecture and content structure to on-page SEO and user experience, I build digital platforms that help businesses improve visibility, attract the right audience, and convert traffic into customers.

I’m passionate about creating solutions that don’t just look polished but actively support business growth. Helping brands evolve, strengthen their presence, and reach their full potential is what motivates the work I bring to every partnership.

positions.title: Web Developer & Designer, Graphic Artist, Marketing Specialist
positions.description:
I help businesses elevate their presence through a blend of strategy, creativity, and technical expertise. With over 15 years of experience, I bring together design, development, marketing, and project management to deliver results-driven solutions that are both visually compelling and strategically effective.

Web Development & Design
Responsive web design, UI/UX, HTML, CSS, CMS (ie. WordPress, Squarespace, WooCommerce, Shopify etc), domain/host/SQL setup, email marketing integration.

Graphic Design
Brand identity, marketing and promotional assets, large-scale displays, textiles, and digital illustration.

Marketing & Strategy
SEO, SEM, analytics, social media + email marketing, client/vendor relations, event coordination, content strategy, campaign management, and media buying.

Additional Capabilities
Copywriting, photography, videography, post-production, print production, product/textile design, and full-scale production coordination.
positions.insights: Web Design, Website Development and +3 skills

positions.title: Web Developer & Designer
positions.description:
Served as Lead Web Developer and Designer, overseeing full project lifecycles from concept through launch. Led project management, collaborated closely with clients, and acted as the key web technology speaker in meetings to ensure solutions aligned with business goals.

• Partnered with clients to design and develop websites, refine content, and deliver seamless UI/UX experiences.
• Led integration of web technologies, including advanced solutions like real estate home search functionality, tailored to client needs.
• Provided expertise across web design + development, UI/UX, digital marketing, copywriting, and client services.
• Drove project management initiatives, ensuring on-time delivery, quality control, and strong client communication.
• Delivered web solutions across a wide range of industries: technology, marketing, investment, hospitality, restaurants, real estate, religious organizations, medical practices, non-profits, and event production.
positions.insights: Website Development, Web Design and +3 skills

positions.title: Google Expeditions - Cardboard VR - Experiential Instructor
positions.description:
The Google Expeditions Pioneer Program brought virtual reality into classrooms, giving students the chance to take virtual field trips around the world.

• Delivered engaging VR learning experiences in schools (grades 2–12), introducing Google Cardboard technology to students, teachers, and staff.

• Facilitated up to three simultaneous classes of 20–30 students, providing software instruction, demonstrations, and hands-on guidance.

• Conducted usability testing with educators, gathering feedback on curriculum integration, user experience, and opportunities for product improvement.

positions.title: Director of Marketing and Creative
positions.description:
Directed PGL’s company-wide rebrand, delivering a full website structure and copywriting overhaul alongside new marketing collateral, social media, and internal communications. Oversaw budgets, vendor relations, event production, estimates/approvals, and the printing and invoicing of all marketing and promotional materials.

•	Implemented a standardized client acquisition strategy that nearly doubled annual sales revenue, earning PGL recognition as the fastest-growing woman-owned freight forwarder in the U.S.
•	Designed and produced investment proposals and RFPs that secured major accounts such as Lockheed Martin, Halliburton, Interstate Battery, Dallas Airmotive, and a government agency partnership.
•	Supported rapid expansion (2012–2013): 15 new locations across the U.S. and overseas, 75% staff growth, and creation of subsidiary Allied Freight Solutions.

Key Contributions:

•	Website structure, design, development, content creation, and SEO programs
•	Copywriting for marketing collateral, proposals, and digital campaigns
•	Estimates, approvals, printing & invoicing for collateral and promotional products
•	Large-scale event coordination (Byron Nelson Partner event)
•	Trade show management: booth design, displays, collateral, and promotional products
•	Business development: market research, workflow development, and sales enablement
•	Photography, video production, and asset management
positions.insights: Marketing Strategy, Website Development and +3 skills

positions.title: Director of Creative Services
positions.description:
Oversaw creative strategy, design, front-end development, eCommerce integration, and content creation, while managing a full in-house creative team. Partnered with the CEO to drive organizational turnaround and new business development through SEO, PPC, affiliate marketing, and digital campaigns.

• Directed brand identity, site design, product development, custom photography, trade show displays, and promotional products.

• Implemented company-wide project management system (Basecamp), improving workflow efficiency and team collaboration.

• Managed quoting, approvals, invoicing, budgets, and vendor relations to ensure on-time, cost-effective delivery of creative and marketing projects.

• Led SEO, PPC, social media, email marketing, and affiliate campaigns to expand market presence and drive revenue growth.

• Recruited and developed in-house creative talent, fostering a culture of innovation and execution.

Key Contributions:

• Creative leadership: identity, branding, marketing collateral, product + display design

• E-commerce strategy: CMS integration, site management, product pricing modules

• Business development: new client acquisition through digital campaigns and market research

• Operations: order management, production oversight, vendor coordination, and print management

volunteerExperiences.description: Assisted in the construction of homes for the less fortunate. It fed my desire to help those in need, all while exercising my love for manual labor, the outdoors, woodworking and building. It was an amazing experience, to say the least.

projects.title: The Door Doctor of South Florida
projects.description:
I partnered with The Door Doctor, a family-owned door and window company serving South Florida, to build a modern digital presence that reflects the quality and professionalism of their work.

I delivered a full-scope transformation including:
- Web Design & Development: A custom WordPress site built for clarity, speed, and conversion — with optimized visuals, responsive design, and intuitive navigation.
- Copywriting & SEO: Comprehensive keyword strategy, on-page optimization, and locally targeted content to strengthen visibility across key South Florida markets.
- Content Marketing: Ongoing blog development focused on SEO growth, customer education, and local authority in garage doors, windows, and entry doors.
- Social Media Management: Strategy, content creation, and scheduling to drive brand awareness, showcase projects, and increase engagement across Facebook and Instagram.
- Digital Marketing & Paid Ads: Integrated campaigns, remarketing, and lead tracking through Google Ads to maximize conversions and ROI.

The result: a cohesive, conversion-driven online presence designed to attract, inform, and convert homeowners across Broward, Palm Beach and Miami-Dade counties.
